_comment: DATA-411: which silence captures pass R10 from an open draft. shown: the reply the agent sent at the ask (with the one question), sent in the session named by shown_by (telegram: a root Telegram session; cron: a cron run; null: no ask was shown). resident_turn: the resident sent any message after the ask (it closes every open ask). age_s: seconds between the ask and the capture (the window is SILENCE_PUBLISH_WINDOW_HOURS, 24 h = 86400 s). session: where the capture is made (cron: a cron send; unknown: a session never seen; telegram: the resident's chat). marker: confirmed_in_chat, or null. text: the capture's exact text. expect: published (source message, publish_via open_draft) or the held code, which is exactly what the tool answered before DATA-411. Checked by plugins/av-events/tests/test_silence_publish.py.
